crime: Every night in her cell, {WITCH_NAME} draws each unwanted touch out of her skin, seals it into a pebble, and adds the pebble to her row.
In the last hour of hot water, a girl who grew up in a bathhouse scrubs {WITCH_NAME}'s back in the shower room, humming the old bathhouse songs.
One evening the girl scrubs harder at the scar on {WITCH_NAME}'s shoulder. "Hold still. This spot won't come off."
Years ago, the village boys threw {WITCH_NAME} into a pigsty, and her mother scrubbed her down with a horse brush. "Hold still. It won't come off." Her shoulder bled, and scarred.
That night she seals the girl's scrubbing into a pebble. It is the first stone in the row that came from the bathhouse girl.

When the last hour of hot water comes again, she offers to sit up with a feverish prisoner in the medical room and lays a cool, wet palm on her forehead. She seals the feel of that palm into the wet cloth on the prisoner's brow, and slips out.
In the shower room, the bathhouse girl is rinsing her hair. {WITCH_NAME} comes up behind her, loops a towel around her throat, and pulls until she stops moving.
All through that hour, the feverish prisoner feels the palm resting on her forehead. It never leaves.
In the trial court, she testifies that {WITCH_NAME}'s palm stayed cool all evening.
Another prisoner catches on the word "cool." A real palm would have warmed against a fevered forehead. What stayed cool was a sealed touch, and the hand it came from had been in the shower room.
fields.epitaph: Of all the stones in her row, only one held a touch meant to make her clean.
fields.epithet: Every Unwanted Touch, Kept in Stone
execution: She is strapped face up on the execution stand, beneath a hopper full of pebbles.
The hopper opens. Smooth grey pebbles pour down steadily, onto her chest, then onto her face.
They keep coming until the mound settles still, and only her open palm shows above the stones.

magic.name: Touchstone
magic.text: She draws a sensation out of anyone she touches and seals it in an object; whoever touches that object feels it.
